Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THERE ARE UNDERGROUND PIPELINES THAT WERE TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE FOR TRANSFERRING OF OIL, BUT WERE USED TO PROTECT NEW GAS LINES.
